why_this_direction: The withdrawn contextual fields did not distinguish their reconstruction error from the recurring computation gap. The next original-only step measures signed full-state residuals with the same outside-fold successful donors for both outcomes, rather than fitting another unexamined target.
repeating_pattern_check: Individual squared losses, correct identity targets and unequal donor treatment repeatedly made complete fields look scientifically sufficient. All existing fitting folds, native rows and merges remain; the statistic removes same-member squared terms, keeps registration error separately and admits no model edit.
hypothesis: A wrong-minus-correct signed residual recurs among distinct fitting members under common held-out donors, beyond the individual reconstruction loss and registration round-trip distortion.
what_went_wrong_before: Scalar successful reconstruction losses were compared with wrong losses under a different donor count, and no signed recurrent component was identified.
rule: Execute exactly the bound source-only signed-residual specification, using all inherited fitting folds and both fixed diagnostic recipes; keep independent unknown channels and original source mass. Publish full-domain diagnostic fold vectors, distinct-member products, native losses and source bindings. Never write targets or weights, execute the model or select a candidate.
prediction: Every fitting member is reconstructed only from outside-fold fitting successes; signed differences and distinct-member products are reported across the complete source schema. Positive recurrence is not by itself capability isolation.
would_weaken_it: Unknown contextual support, opposed or weak distinct-member products, dependence on round-trip distortion or contradictory fold/estimator signs weaken the signed recurring construction. Group-correlated wording remains a possible cause even when recurrence is present.

revisions.reason: First invocation stopped in source-metadata preparation with KeyError: tokens, before factory.json or any computed field was written. Preserve run.log; the loader now retains tokens and recorded_tokens required by the existing row mapper, with a focused fixture and twelve tests passing. Scientific recipes, split, metric and sources are unchanged.

fitting.derivation: Import the exact fitting IDs and existing tube.picks folds; each recipient is held once and its donors are all successes outside its fold.

estimators.derivation: Exact rational affine coefficients and maximal exact parameter matches; apply the same outside-fold donor IDs to both outcomes.
estimators.scales_with: Question contexts, donor design rank and source registration.

recurrence.derivation: Squared difference of group mean vectors minus each group's within-group sum of squared deviations divided by n*(n-1); retain negative and unknown values.
recurrence.scales_with: Source group counts and full feature dimensions.

mass.derivation: Each original row contributes 1/native_member_rows divided equally among its registered matches; average across fitting members and source merges.
mass.scales_with: Every original row, registered correspondence and merge count.

native_loss.derivation: Same 1/(groups*group_members*member_native_rows*merges) per channel; missing rows retain their denominator.

precision.derivation: Float64 derived arithmetic and arrays; original fitting-slice hashes checked against the completed compilation before terminal transformation.
precision.scales_with: Native source representation and declared relative-state features.

storage.derivation: Keep all fold gaps and scalar recurrence/member diagnostics at every place/merge; wide per-member residuals are recomputable intermediates. Logical output bytes counted from exact source shapes and dtype before execution.
storage.scales_with: Members, folds, places, width, merges and fixed diagnostic variants.

disk_floor.derivation: Existing machine minimum of 40 GB free, expressed in bytes; not an experimental threshold.
disk_floor.scales_with: Machine requirement; output demand scales with the source schema.
